items.title: CFTC Wants to Drop Gemini’s $5M Settlement. A Judge Just Said No
items.summary: The judge ruled that a shift in the CFTC’s enforcement priorities and misconduct allegations against its enforcement division weren’t enough to reopen a deal Gemini signed weeks before trial.

items.title: NEAR Intents Postmortem Links $3.8 Million Exploit to Deposit Bug
items.summary: The protocol removed deposit notifications after another critical bug report and says all affected users were made whole.

items.title: Crypto Biz: Wall Street closes at 4. Tokenized stocks keep trading
items.summary: Tokenized stocks are drawing trading activity beyond Wall Street hours, while Bitcoin miners confront costly AI expansion and new accounting rules could benefit stablecoins.

items.title: Circle details USDC revenue split, says $819 million went to partners and costs in H1 2026
items.summary: Circle breaks down its USDC revenue: about $1.4 billion in H1 2026, $819 million to partners and transaction costs, $473 million reinvested.
